agentHint: Lets ssh and git use the Ed25519 keys in your SSH Key items. The private keys never leave the app; each key asks for your OK once per unlock.
configHint: Add this to ~/.ssh/config (or set SSH_AUTH_SOCK to the address):
noKeys: No SSH Key items yet. Create one with + New item › SSH Key and paste the private key.
problem_unreadable: Not an OpenSSH Ed25519 private key: the agent cannot use it.
problem_encrypted: Protected by a passphrase: add a field called “passphrase” with it.
approveText: A program wants to use the SSH key “{title}”. Allow it until Password365 locks?
